title: Tableau Workbook
description: A Tableau workbook containing one or more views (worksheets, dashboards, or stories) that connect to data sources and provide interactive visual analytics.

id.description: The unique identifier (LUID) for the workbook.

name.description: The name of the workbook as it appears on the server.

description.description: A user-provided description of the workbook.

contentUrl.description: The URL-friendly name of the workbook used in the content URL path. Automatically generated from the workbook name.

webpageUrl.description: The full URL to view the workbook in a web browser on Tableau Server or Tableau Cloud.

showTabs.description: Whether the workbook displays views as navigable tabs.

size.description: The size of the workbook file in bytes.

createdAt.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp when the workbook was first published to the server.

updatedAt.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp when the workbook was last modified or republished.

encryptExtracts.description: Whether extracts embedded in the workbook are encrypted at rest.

defaultViewId.description: The ID of the view that is displayed by default when the workbook is opened.

tags.description: Tags associated with the workbook for categorization and search.

views.description: The views (worksheets, dashboards, and stories) contained in the workbook.

connections.description: The data connections used by the workbook.

dataAccelerationConfig.description: Configuration for Data Acceleration on the workbook.

ProjectReference.description: A reference to the project that contains the workbook.

id.description: The unique identifier for the project.

OwnerReference.description: A reference to the user who owns the workbook.

id.description: The unique identifier for the owner.

name.description: The display name of the owner.

View.description: A view (worksheet, dashboard, or story) within a workbook.

id.description: The unique identifier for the view.

contentUrl.description: The URL-friendly name used in the content URL.

viewUrlName.description: The URL-safe name of the view.

sheetType.description: The type of sheet: worksheet, dashboard, or story.

updatedAt.description: When the view was last updated.

Connection.description: A data connection within a workbook, representing a link to a data source.

id.description: The unique identifier for the connection.

type.description: The type of data connection (e.g., sqlserver, postgres, mysql, oracle, snowflake, bigquery, redshift, excel, hyper, textscan, googlesheets).

serverAddress.description: The hostname or IP address of the database server.

serverPort.description: The port number used for the connection.

userName.description: The user name used to authenticate with the data source.

datasource.description: Reference to the published data source, if applicable.

id.description: The ID of the published data source.

name.description: The name of the published data source.

Tag.description: A tag label applied to content for organization and discoverability.

totalViewCount.description: The total number of times the content has been viewed.

Revision.description: A published revision of the workbook.

deleted.description: Whether this revision has been deleted.

current.description: Whether this is the current (latest) revision.

sizeInBytes.description: The size of this revision in bytes.

Permission.description: A permission rule granting or denying capabilities to a user or group.

id.description: The ID of the user grantee.
The ID of the group grantee.

mode.description: Whether the capability is allowed or denied.
